title: Fixed Broad Blunt Blade and Crosswise Palm Grip Bench Scraper
description: One newly authored complete static bakery bench-scraper exterior. One whole broad nearly rectangular finite plate has a continuous straight blunt lower edge, full front/back surfaces and clipped upper corners. Its entire upper edge enters a separate full crosswise rounded palm grip with complete capped ends; there is no long axial handle, return hook, cutting arm, feed bed or serving slot. The plate and grip form one whole bench-tool silhouette, not the narrow hooked hive scraper widened, a mandoline deck detached or an old blade cropped. All numerical geometry new, two opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and whole bounds-centred lower-edge display datum. One original model zero scenes. Fixed blunt artistic geometry only: no dough, food contact, cutting/scraping, portion measure, grip fit, heat tolerance, cleaning, hygiene, load, manufacture or safety capability; lower edge is only a display datum, not a stable working stance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
